additional_info.body:
Hello Mert,
How far is this site from your location?
Is there anyone nearby who can unplug the USB from HMI and PLC and plug it again?
Because we need to be sure everything is checked, if it is a calibration issue or actually HMI needs replacement.
Please plan for inspection, only if the site is nearby and doesn't involve travel cost.
Else you can plan for the site visit with HMI replacement, however before replacement you can check the USB cable connection and contact us to remotely calibrate the HMI.
If problem doesn't fix, you can proceed with the replacement.
I hope the above solution is acceptable to you, if yes, do I have your consent to transfer the case to RC-TR queue for field service?
